query: INSERT INTO metadata_versions (manifestation_id, source, field_name, new_value, value_hash, match_type, status, confidence_score, last_seen_at) SELECT $1, 'opf', 'description', to_jsonb('draft ' || g.n), decode(lpad(to_hex(g.n), 8, '0'), 'hex'), 'title', 'pending'::metadata_review_status, 0.5, now() - (g.n || ' seconds')::interval FROM generate_series(1, 250) AS g(n)
